suppress.evidence: The draft attaches the later stages to distar.5010 through hidden carrier events; the real order is 5010 → (5002) 5003 → (5004) 5005 → (5006) 5007 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:113-553).
Same: the hatching (5007) comes only after 5003 and 5005 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:288-553).
5013 is the alternative to 5004/5005 after the tremors 5003 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:153-176).

label.zh: 蛋继续裂开（约60%）：60-160天后进入第二阶段
label.en: The egg keeps cracking (about 60%): stage 2 after 60-160 days

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:155 has_carrier_flag = hatchling_will_trigger → carrier_event distar.5004 days 60 random 100 → owner gets distar.5005 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:235-288); the flag is set on the egg planet with 60% (common/solar_system_initializers/distant_stars_initializers.txt:1237).

events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:164-176 otherwise → distar.5013 days 30 random 60; initializer 40% branch without hatchling_will_trigger (common/solar_system_initializers/distant_stars_initializers.txt:1237).

label.zh: 60-150天后蛋壳破裂，虚空孳孽孵出
label.en: After 60-150 days the egg cracks and the Voidspawn hatches

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:288-300 carrier_event distar.5006 days 60 random 90; distar.5006 (hidden) destroys the colony, turns the planet into pc_egg_cracked and notifies the owner with distar.5007 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:339-491); 70 days later distar.50061 creates the Voidspawn country and boss fleet.

label.zh: 舰队进入虚空孳孽所在的星系
label.en: A fleet enters the system where the Voidspawn lives

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1006 on_entering_system_fleet → distar.5011 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:775): a fleet of a guardian_hatchling country is in the system and the owner has not yet encountered the hatchling.
common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1655 on_fleet_destroyed_perp → distar.5009 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:815): the destroyed fleet's country has flag hatchling_country.

label.zh: 清空蛋裂缝矿藏后，行星复原
label.en: Once the egg-crack deposits are cleared the planet is restored

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:102 on_monthly_pulse → distar.5014 (hidden, events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:685): planet flag egg_interrupted and no d_egg_cracking deposit left → entity restored and distar.5015 shown.

label.en: The egg keeps cracking or stops

note.zh: 蛋行星初始化时60%带 hatchling_will_trigger（继续裂开→大灾变→孵化），40%没有（地震停止→5013）。
note.en: At spawn the egg planet gets hatchling_will_trigger with 60% (keeps cracking → Cataclysm → hatching) or not with 40% (quakes stop → 5013).

note.zh: 没有孵化；清除裂缝后行星复原。
note.en: No hatching; the planet is restored once the cracks are cleared.

scope.zh: 异常定义（生成条件、等级、次数限制）与全部结果事件已对照源文件核对。
scope.en: Anomaly definition (spawn conditions, level, once-limits) and every outcome event checked against the source.

uncertain: distar.5001 (monthly) also starts stage 1 for an owned-but-uncolonised egg without going through distar.5010; the compiled tree shows only the colonisation entry.
